title: Paris fads
html_source: As we learn about more in chapter 3, “Proteus”, Stephen moved to Paris after his undergraduate studies. Joyce’s previous novel, A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man, ends with Stephen Dedalus dramatically announcing his move to Paris, hoping to find a world of spiritual and artistic freedom there he felt absent in Ireland. In Ulysses we learn Stephen, like Joyce in real life, only lived in Paris a short while before returning to Ireland when his mother was dying. Stephen found his life and his accomplishments in Paris very disappointing, but his thoughts frequently return to it throughout Ulysses. Mulligan here insinuates that drinking tea without milk, in the French style, is a habit Stephen picked up in Paris.
